message.reasoning:
We need to decide whether to bid or drop out. Current high bid 146 by Beta (p2). We have cash 260. We own two railroads. Utility is less valuable but can be good with both utilities. Opponent Gamma already owns Electric Company and Water Works, so they have both utilities. Actually Gamma holds both utilities, so they get 10x dice roll. So buying Electric Company is not beneficial unless we can later trade. Could be valuable for trade. Our cash 260, we could bid maybe up to 200? But we need to consider other upcoming purchases. We have two railroads, good. We have cash 260, other players have cash: Beta 720, Gamma 850, Delta 540. They have more cash. If we overpay, we reduce liquidity. Might be better to drop out and keep cash for other properties. Also we could try to bid low to maybe get it cheap if others drop out. But currently Beta is leading with 146. Minimum next bid 147. If we bid 147, we become leader. Then others may drop out. But Beta might outbid again. We could try to force Beta to spend more, but they have lots of cash. Might not be effective.

Given we have 260 cash, we could afford up to maybe 200, but we need to keep cash for houses later. Utility not essential. I'd drop out to conserve cash, maybe try to trade later.

Thus choose drop_out.

Public message: maybe say "I'll pass on this utility." Private thought: reasoning.

Make tool call drop_out with messages.
